messages:
Noah: Serious but silly poll for the night  if you could banish one household chore forever (someone else does it, never think about it again), which one would it be? be specific. :house_with_garden:
Elena: Dishes. I will gladly be judged for stacking a dishwasher for money. :plate_with_cutlery:
Kai: Folding laundry. My shirts and I have an unspoken agreement to never meet neatly. :t_shirt:
Priya: Vacuuming. Carpet and I are on different life paths. :broom:
Marco: Grocery shopping. Im allergic to impulse purchases at 7pm. :shopping_cart:
Noah: Love the honesty. add one rule: you cant replace it with something worse (e.g., more closet space).
Elena: Fine, but the dishwasher is a magical portal to a cleaner timeline.
PollBot: Poll created: 1) Dishes (Elena) 2) Folding laundry (Kai) 3) Vacuuming (Priya) 4) Grocery shopping (Marco). Vote with emoji reactions.
Kai: also pro tip: if someone takes my laundry chore away, I will nominate them for a medal. :medal:
Priya: If vacuuming disappears, I promise to be nice to plants. :seedling:
Marco: Will the person who takes grocery duty be allowed to send snack requests? Asking for my stomach. :pleading_face:
Noah: Winners get eternal gratitude and a snack request form. Ill compile results tomorrow and make a tiny chart for inspiration. :bar_chart:
Elena: if dishes win Ill start a celebratory dance. video or it didnt happen. :man_dancing:
Kai: I will accept chore fame silently. :zipper_mouth_face:
Priya: also adding: if vacuuming is gone, I get to pick the next silly question. stakes. :sparkles:
Marco: Remind me later to ask for the snack form template. Im thinking croissants. :croissant:
Noah: Noted. Poll closes in 24h. Good night, champions of domestic peace. :crescent_moon:
